observations: Photo 0 shows two keyboards on a tiered stand; the bottom one is the subject.
The bottom keyboard has a silver/grey chassis with 88 keys.
A blue backlit LCD screen is located in the center of the control panel.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is printed on the panel above the keys in photo 0.
Model text is present on the right side of the panel but is too blurry to read in photo 0.
The image contains a watermark for 'PRIME AUDIO'.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but the model number on the right of the panel is illegible in photo 0.
No power adapter is shown in the photo.

risks.risk: The LCD screen on this series is prone to fading or developing lines (screen rot).
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen powered on.
risks.if_unproven: as having a failing or unreadable display

risks.risk: Individual keys may have lost sensitivity or stopped working entirely.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across the full length of the keyboard with sound.

risks.risk: The internal speakers or audio outputs may produce static or crackling.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the keyboard playing at various volumes.

proof_requests: A clear, high-resolution photo of the model name printed on the right side of the keyboard panel.
A video of the keyboard powered on, showing the screen clearly and playing every key to confirm sound and action.
A photo of the power adapter, specifically the label showing its specifications.
response.reason: The specific model number cannot be read from the photo, and for a digital piano of this age, proof of screen health and key functionality is required to establish a baseline value.
